suggestions.quote: At eighty, the shout from age nine is as loud as this morning
suggestions.fix: Do not build a new old-age set or a new rig. Reuse the night room and the kitchen, swap in grey hair and a stick on the same figure, and keep it one sheet of pages drifting, so it stays buildable this week.

suggestions.quote: Your room papered with every page you have read
suggestions.fix: Make this the wordless peak (8 to 10 s). The room set from the opening is layered with page sprites, with a slow camera pull-back and the crimson shout sliding in from the left, so something moves every 2 to 4 s. Mom stays in a pastel head; only the shout bubble is crimson.

suggestions.quote: The exam hall is one row of desks as a drifting layer
suggestions.fix: Keep it to that one row of desks. Hide the stranger (crimson head, dark coat) at the far end of the row for the second watch, and keep the pages and the stranger in colour while the hall greys.

suggestions.quote: the internship boss's late messages, the ad on the metro
suggestions.fix: Show the messages as unreadable ruled-sheet scribbles or a bubble of four words or fewer from the boss (tie). Show the metro ad as a flat panel with no text. No readable on-screen text beyond tags, counters and bubbles.

suggestions.quote: you expect an apology, you get a blank
suggestions.fix: Stage the blank as a face reaction within 2 s: mom's rig does a puzzled brow-up and a neutral mouth, you do a sad or shocked brow. Use the existing tea prop and shawl so no new prop is needed.

suggestions.quote: The turn breaks "Forgetting is losing": forgetting was how you two forgave each other.
suggestions.fix: For G2, put a one-word intent in `cues.yaml` for each beat and name the music in and out cues. The cue intent shift must land at or after this turn, not before it. `cues.yaml` is not in my inputs, so I could not check it.

suggestions.quote: the pages settle on the desk
suggestions.fix: Keep the right third of the frame quiet in the last 15 s, with the desk and the tea at left. The end card tags sit in the left two-thirds.

keep.quote: She doesn't remember the shout. You do. The tea's still warm.
Then the question quotes no page; it asks you to apply one to something new, and you freeze.
the lamp on, your hands up, pages swirling round your head, the crimson shout with mom's face from when you were nine
